name: Hannah Yeoh
_note: M2 full-cabinet completion: Minister of Youth and Sports from 3 Dec 2022; moved to Federal Territories on 17 Dec 2025. The Layer B pass assesses her Youth and Sports tenure. periods.office: Minister of Youth and Sports (Dec 2022-Dec 2025; moved to Federal Territories in the 16 Dec 2025 reshuffle)

metrics.justification: No personal criminal or anti-corruption matter of record. A 2024 examination of a Selangor state contract awarded to a firm co-founded by her husband was publicly found by the anti-corruption commission to involve no conflict and no offence (the contract was a state-government award, not her ministry's); a separate matter was a civil defamation case. Neither is an integrity matter against her.

citation.title: Azam Baki says MACC found no conflict over Yeoh's husband's transport deal with Selangor

metrics.justification: On the football association's falsified-documents crisis (after a FIFA finding, Oct 2025) she urged a transparent response, temporarily halted extra ministry funding, and set up an independent committee led by a former Chief Justice; she also reversed a sports body's threatened suspension of a Paralympic gold medallist in a reward dispute (Sep 2025). Decisive, measurable interventions on crises that originated outside her ministry (anchor 3).

citation.title: Extra funding for FAM to be temporarily halted, says Hannah

metrics.justification: Delivered an operative Safe Sport Code protecting athletes from abuse (effective 2023, with a safeguarding officer and live caseload) and an expanded sports tax relief (from assessment year 2025); the Sports Development Act amendment was still at review stage, not tabled, when she moved portfolios. Operative measures delivered, one reform pending (anchor 3).

citation.title: Hannah Yeoh: Implementation of Safe Sports Code to be expanded nationwide

metrics.justification: Established an external committee to investigate the football-association crisis and pressed sports bodies to adopt written athlete-reward contracts modelled on the Road to Gold approach. Useful governance instruments, but ad hoc and not yet durable institutional strengthening (anchor 2).

citation.title: Hannah Yeoh: Adopt Road to Gold's contract-first approach to avoid repeat of Cheah Liek Hou reward row

metrics.justification: Publicly apologised to Malaysians for the Paris 2024 no-gold result while defending the long-term Road to Gold design, owning a disappointing outcome on the record; against this she distanced her ministry from the criticised Olympic tracksuit as outside its jurisdiction. Candour on the result mixed with a deflection (anchor 2).

citation.title: Paris 2024: Youth Minister Hannah Yeoh apologises as Malaysia misses out on gold
